content: Yona iyoho moti tinena gamwanaa, inoke i awanun wana Yabowaine Yehoba elana,

content.text: O Yehoba, no minanakina elana ya yoga elam,
inoke anau u lahe.
Yaomal hot elana ya awanun labe kaiwena,
inoke anau u hago.
U alipalowau hogaa
ya lau limwan gamwanaa hot,
hoga i mipainagau.
Wam bagol bwabwatal hi bini pwatawa.
Ya ba, “Iyaka u patuna owaowa-agau matamwa,
yaa matau na lihin al elam wam Limi Bwabwalena elana.”
Hoga i yabomwau kelaubwa na unun,
limwan i mipainagau,
lumun
kaunu i avan.
Ya lobek ya na paiya hot o siga oya wali siun i telipunaa,
ya lau ya na Tuma, iya nige bosowaina gamagal naha tagila.
Yaa owa, Yehoba no Yabowaine, yawaliu u momol heyanem panuwa milalauina o elana.
Sauga yawaliu kelaubwa ni mowasi,
Yehoba ya nuwahikagiwa.
No awanun i ha elam
i na wam Limi Bwabwalena elana.
Bolo hi kukululuek yabowaine kakawel elal,
iyaka hi towaagiwa, nige hi nunuwana-agiwa.
Yaa alou no ba mulolu bwasumu na powonan eliyam,
ge na ginol ni ola no bateli eliyam.
Pwamwal i noem Yehoba eliyam.

content: Inoke Yehoba i ba moti i na Yona i mamanuvi-an datuwa.

footnotes.text: Ta ba “lumun” o ebo ta ba “molumolu.”
